text: The shopman invited us into his showroom, and before I could say that we were in a hurry, we were already standing inside it. <break time="0.8s" /> He picked a wriggling red demon off my sleeve and threw it behind a counter, saying that I must have brought it in myself. <break time="0.8s" /> Gip pointed at a magic sword, and the shopman explained that it would make its owner unbeatable against anyone under eighteen. <break time="0.8s" /> Holding the shopmans finger, Gip wandered happily among the stands, and I must admit that I felt a little jealous. <break time="0.8s" /> The showroom was a winding maze of pillars, stands, and mirrors, and soon I could not find the door at all. <break time="0.8s" /> There was also a box of soldiers that came to life when you lifted the lid and said a special word. <break time="0.8s" /> Gip learned the word at once, and the box was quickly wrapped and labeled with his full name and address. <break time="0.8s" /> This is the genuine magic, said the shopman, and I answered that it was perhaps a little too genuine for me. <break time="0.8s" /> The shelves seemed to move whenever I was not looking, and the masks near the ceiling looked far too alive. <break time="0.8s" /> Then I saw one of the shop assistants stretch his nose out like a long red whip, and a cold feeling came over me.
